title: Naturality of supplied models for an actual derived arrow
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]. Use the specified TestModel, sourceModel, targetModel, chainRestriction, modelMap and localizationModel [def-sfb-closed-test-scalar-model-diagrams]. Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $a\subseteq A$ an ideal, $X$ affine, $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$, and $(h:X_Z\to X,f_Z:X_Z\to\operatorname{Spec}(A/a))$ the pullback of $f$ along the closed immersion [def-pc-fibre-product, def-weil-closed-immersion]. Let $V$ be an affine pro-etale test over $\operatorname{Spec}(A/a)$ such that both $V$ and its specified closed-site lift are w-contractible [def-exc-closed-site-lift, sk-def-pe-wlocal]. For arbitrary unbounded derived $\Lambda_X$-modules $K,N$, every actual derived arrow $\alpha:K\to N$ and supplied TestModels $M,P$ of $K,N$, ModelMapCoherence(A,a,f,h,f_Z,w,V,alpha,M,P) holds. Thus modelMap commutes with both normalized models, chainRestriction, and both localization models. It depends only on the actual derived arrow.

proof.text: Represent e.hom alpha d.inv by a chain map into the supplied K-injective target J. Computation-unit naturality identifies the formula for modelMap with Q(F b). Naturality of any complex-level comparison sigma and cancellation of d.inv d.hom then give naturality after arbitrary representative isomorphisms.

Build the complex-level natural transformations out of the actual closed unit, evaluation computation units, exact pullback factors and direct-image computation units. Their components, followed by the image of e.hom, are exactly sourceModel, targetModel and localizationModel. Apply the first step to obtain four squares.
Apply the separate chain-restriction naturality calculation to obtain the third square. Together with the four natural transformation squares this is ModelMapCoherence.

theorem closed_test_model_map_naturality
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (a : Ideal A)
    {X XZ : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine X] (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of A))
    (h : XZ ⟶ X) (fZ : XZ ⟶ Spec (.of (A ⧸ a)))
    (w : IsPullback h fZ f (closedMap A a))
    (V : (Spec (.of (A ⧸ a))).AffineProEt)
    [IsWContractibleRing Γ(V.left, ⊤)]
    [IsWContractibleRing Γ((liftedTest A a V).left, ⊤)]
    {K N : DerivedCategory
      (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X))}
    (α : K ⟶ N) (M : TestModel Λ h K) (P : TestModel Λ h N) :
    ModelMapCoherence A a f h fZ w V α M P
